'''Hasslo''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi instructor|Jedi combat instructor]], during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Olive-skinned, Hasslo had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and diamond-shaped [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] on his chin, wearing white [[Armor/Legends|armor]] over brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]]. While he was bald, Hasslo had black [[Hair/Legends|eyebrows]], and he wielded a single [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The Jedi Master was stationed at the [[Minimum Security Section]] of the [[Belsavis prison|Republic prison complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hasslo first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], as a trainer for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class on the planet Belsavis.<ref name="TOR" />
